definitions.explanation: A curved or flat piece of fired clay or other material used to cover roofs.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{瓦|かわら}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{飛|と}んだ→飛ぶ：00759_tobu⟧。
examples.english: The roof tiles blew off in the typhoon.

examples.japanese: {瓦|かわら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{葺|ふ}き{替|か}える→葺き替える：noentry⟧⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: They're doing construction to re-tile the roof.

notes:
{瓦|かわら} refers to traditional Japanese roof tiles, typically made of fired clay.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {瓦|かわら}⟦{屋根|やね}→屋根：02264_yane⟧ (tiled roof)
- {瓦|かわら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{葺|ふ}く→葺く：noentry⟧ (to tile a roof)
- {瓦|かわら}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ちる→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧ (tiles fall off)

TYPES:
- ⟦{鬼瓦|おにがわら}→鬼瓦：noentry⟧ (decorative demon tile at roof ends)
- ⟦{平瓦|ひらがわら}→平瓦：noentry⟧ (flat tiles)
- ⟦{丸瓦|まるがわら}→丸瓦：noentry⟧ (round/cylindrical tiles)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Traditional Japanese roof tiles are typically gray or black. Red-brown tiles are more common in Okinawa.
